experiment.name: in-batch frozen-scope escalation
experiment.hypothesis: A selected exact outside-copper blocker can terminate the remaining large native batch and immediately enlarge regional ownership.

v6.cause: rank-zero scope interruption changed the regional handoff

v7.cause: removing the batch barrier was insufficient because rank-zero interruption still fired in earlier physical epochs

candidate_progress_at_timeout.meaning: Each listed window consumed the full eight-candidate active tier and an eight-candidate fallback tier before the batch completed.

interpretation.earliest_supported_mechanism: The native fallback tiers are scheduled depth-first inside each window. Many windows exhaust both tiers while later windows remain uncharacterised. Candidate-level outside blockers are common but were not decisive selected failures.
interpretation.next_hypothesis: Run the active native tier breadth-first across every independent window, reduce a complete first-tier checkpoint, then apply fallback tiers only to the remaining failed windows in parallel. Preserve every fallback and exact legality gate; change ordering only.
